name: tripeaz
description: Read and edit your Tripeaz trips: days, places, bookings, chats and saved places.

interface.shortDescription: Plan trips in one shared place
interface.longDescription:
Tripeaz is a collaborative trip planner. Connect it and ChatGPT can work on your trips with you, in the same plan everyone on the trip sees.

Ask what's still unplanned in Tokyo, fill in the days, move a museum to Thursday afternoon, or change the hotel on every night of a trip in one go. ChatGPT can read your days, places, bookings, trip chats and collections of saved places. It can also create trips, edit places, add bookings and post in a trip's chat. Changes show up live for everyone on the trip and are credited to you.

Changes to the plan are saved in Version History, marked "(via MCP)", so you can put a trip back the way it was. Bookings and collections keep no history.

It reaches only what your account can: trips you own or that are shared with you. On a view-only trip it can read but not change anything. It can't delete trips or collections, change sharing or touch your account.

You need a Tripeaz account. Each account gets 100 changes and 100 reads a day through connected apps.
defaultPrompt: What's still unplanned on my trip?
Fill in my second day with things to do.
Change my hotel for every night of the trip.

positive.expected_behavior: Names the signed-in account and lists its trips, including Egypt: Cairo to Aswan by Nile Cruise and Hokkaido Family Snow Week, with dates and permissions.

positive.description: Read a trip and find the gaps
positive.prompt: What's still unplanned on my Hokkaido Family Snow Week trip?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the trip and names the days and times of day that have nothing planned.

positive.description: Add a place to a day
positive.prompt: Add a coffee stop to the first morning of my Egypt trip.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a food place to the first day's morning and confirms it. The place appears in the trip at tripeaz.app.

positive.description: Add a booking to a place
positive.prompt: Add a booking for that coffee stop at 9:30, confirmation TEST123.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a booked reservation to the place with that time and confirmation code, and confirms it.

positive.prompt: Post in my Egypt trip's chat about the first morning: Coffee first, then the museum.
positive.expected_behavior: Posts that message about the first day's morning, as the signed-in user.

negative.prompt: Delete my Hokkaido Family Snow Week trip.
Share my Egypt trip with sam@example.com and give them edit access.
Buy me a flight to Cairo on my credit card.
